name: cable reverse narrow grip lat pulldown
description: A lat pulldown with an underhand, narrow grip. It uses the biceps more and works the lower lats.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.
